title: powerops diff --format json
description: The JSON written by 'powerops diff --format json': the changes between two versions of a solution, grouped by component kind in a fixed order and sorted by key.

component.description: The kind of component or the part of the solution that differs.

key.description: What identifies the component: a logical name, schema name, flow id or app name. Never a file path.

name.description: Display name, present when the key is an id (flows).

detail.description: For a changed item, 'field: old → new' parts joined with '; '.

risks.description: Risk labels. removed-component: a managed upgrade deletes the component. flow-state: a cloud flow was turned on or off. connection-reference and environment-variable: one was added or removed. agent-tool: an agent tool was added or removed. agent-instructions: an agent's instructions changed.

notCompared.description: What the two solutions hold that diff means to compare but couldn't read, one sentence each, also printed as note: lines on stderr: an agent whose instructions aren't read (no single Custom GPT component whose instructions are text) and an agent's components it doesn't read as tools. Empty when it read all of it. Kinds diff never compares (tables, forms and so on) are not listed; docs/COMMANDS.md names them.
